γ = (Eslab - n × Ebulk/N) / (2A)

where:
- Eslab is the total energy of the slab
- Ebulk is the total energy of the bulk system
- n is the number of atoms in the slab
- N is the number of atoms in the bulk
- A is the surface area
- The factor 2 accounts for the two surfaces created
